title: Son of Dracula
description:
S1
Count Alucard comes out of a lake in his coffin and makes a Southern belle his bride.

title: Son of Frankenstein
description:
S1
The baron's son (Basil Rathbone) revives his father's monster (Boris Karloff) with help from a broken-necked shepherd called Ygor (Bela Lugosi).

title: Sssssss
description:
S1
A snake scientist (Strother Martin) turns his daughter's (Heather Menzies) boyfriend (Dirk Benedict), his lab helper, into a big cobra.

title: Tarantula
description:
S1
Desert scientists (John Agar, Mara Corday, Leo G. Carroll) try to stop a fortified spider the size of a building.

title: Tremors
description:
S1
Four big worms with multiple tongues dig high-speed around people (Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter) in the middle of nowhere.

title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
description:
S1
The Mexican government hires two handymen (Fred Ward, Michael Gross) to battle huge man-eating worms plaguing an oil field.

title: The Werewolf of London
description:
S1
An Asian werewolf (Warner Oland) bites a botanist (Henry Hull) in Tibet and rivals him for the antidote in London.

title: The Wolf Man
description:
S1
Bitten by a werewolf, an aristocrat (Lon Chaney) grows fangs, fur and a muzzle, then begs his father (Claude Rains) for help.

title: Altered
description:
S1
Fifteen years after they were abducted by aliens, four men get a chance to take revenge when they capture one of the creatures.
